_comment: A multi-turn transcript, long enough that exact Shapley over every sentence is out of reach. Coarse-to-fine attributes the turns exactly, then re-attributes inside only the turns that carried weight. Run with: jev-xray explain examples/transcript.json -q refund_requested --method drill
state:
Customer: My order A-104 arrived yesterday and the outer box was crushed on one corner. The jacket itself looks fine honestly. I have not worn it yet.
Agent: Thanks for flagging that. I can see the order on your account and it shipped on the 2nd.
Customer: I have been shopping with you since 2019 and never had a problem before. I am not sure whether to send it back or just keep it at a discount. Your policy page says damaged items qualify for a full refund. Let me know what my options are.
Agent: I can offer either. Which would you prefer?
Customer: Honestly whichever is faster. I need something to wear this weekend.

refund_requested.instructions: The customer is asking for their money back.

criteria.true: The customer wants a refund, stated or clearly implied
criteria.false: The customer wants something else, or has not asked for anything yet

needs_human.instructions: This conversation needs a human agent rather than an automated reply.
